commit.message:
chore(deps): update rou3 to v0.11

- rules: drop per-method materialization of agnostic rules (rou3 now pools a node's `""` and method-scoped registrations; the copies duplicated layers)
- rules/compiler: use `compileRouterToString` options object
- test: `:name` no longer matches an empty segment
